name: How long does a typical luxury backyard renovation project take from design to completion?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical luxury backyard renovation project take from design to completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a luxury backyard renovation varies significantly based on complexity and scope. A comprehensive project, including design, permitting, material selection, and construction, can range from 4 to 12 months, or even longer for very extensive designs. Initial design and planning often take 1-3 months, followed by permit acquisition which can add 1-4 months. Construction itself for elements like pools, outdoor kitchens, and intricate landscaping typically spans 2-6 months. We prioritize detailed planning to provide accurate timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury backyard renovations can take 4 to 12 months or more, depending on scope, including design, permitting, and construction phases.
